newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Feeling down in Siberia? Get stoned, expert says.
newsitem.headline: Feeling down in Siberia? Get stoned, expert says.

text.p: Feeling off colour? Afraid of catching 'flu? Try munching on a stone.
This advice comes all the way from the snowy wastes of Siberia where people and animals have been eating stones for centuries.
Now, after 15 years of research into "edible stones", Siberian scientist Vasily Bgatov has come up with evidence they have medical benefits, Itar-Tass news agency reported.
He studied the grit-munching habits of elks, Siberian stag, Manchurian deer, snow rams and other animals across a wide area.
"Analysis and experiments gave significant evidence showing minerals absorbed from them boosted the body's immune system."

It does help if you live in Siberia, where, according to Bgatov, there are several types of healthy stone. He has come up with a food additive made from one type he recommends -- zeolite wheat and rye.
